title: Honua metadata and catalog endpoint inventory

surfaceAlignment.catalogRole: Public standards catalog and cross-protocol discovery surface once honua-io/honua-server#952 lands.
surfaceAlignment.sourceOfTruth: Metadata v2 canonical resource metadata plus safe service, layer, source-descriptor, STAC, and protocol projections.
surfaceAlignment.sdkParityGate: SDK Records clients wait for honua-io/honua-server#952 to finalize route, query, pagination, auth, error, and raw-payload behavior.

surfaceAlignment.catalogRole: Public open-data page, DCAT/data.json catalog, and Schema.org Dataset JSON-LD preview surface for Console-published items when OpenData:Enabled is true.
surfaceAlignment.sourceOfTruth: Console open-data page records and Console content items are projected into anonymous public page/catalog read models.
surfaceAlignment.sdkParityGate: SDK open-data clients must preserve non-leaking anonymous 404 behavior, cursor paging, application/ld+json Schema.org negotiation, disabled-capability handling, documented validation exceptions, and raw DCAT catalog payload access.

surfaceAlignment.catalogRole: Operator control-plane discovery, Metadata v2 authoring, manifest workflows, source descriptors, Console publication state, and SDK compatibility handshakes.
surfaceAlignment.sourceOfTruth: Admin metadata resources, catalog tables, and server-owned Console publication records remain the control-plane source; protocol and public catalog surfaces are projections or read models.
surfaceAlignment.sdkParityGate: SDKs must call /api/v1/admin/capabilities before constructing admin paths and must preserve envelopes, ETags, feature flags, and precondition errors.

surfaceAlignment.catalogRole: Asset and spatiotemporal catalog/search surface for STAC clients.
surfaceAlignment.sourceOfTruth: STAC is a standards projection of cataloged resources and assets. Console-managed STAC publication state contributes collection/catalog entries, while item/search data remains backed by Metadata v2 publication bindings.
surfaceAlignment.sdkParityGate: SDK STAC clients must preserve STAC-native links, item paging, filter/search semantics, ETags, and raw item payload access.

surfaceAlignment.catalogRole: External source assessment and planning artifact chain before import, pilot, or cutover.
surfaceAlignment.sourceOfTruth: Migration artifacts capture what ArcGIS, GeoServer, or OGC sources advertised; they become Honua catalog truth only after reviewed import or publication.
surfaceAlignment.sdkParityGate: SDK migration clients must keep source inventory, manifest, parity evidence, readiness states, and stable compatibility codes intact.

surfaceAlignment.catalogRole: Exact client-facing capability, schema, service, layer, collection, scene, or CSDL metadata for one protocol family.
surfaceAlignment.sourceOfTruth: Protocol documents are generated from catalog resources, service settings, layer metadata, and runtime capabilities; they should not replace the canonical admin catalog.
surfaceAlignment.sdkParityGate: SDK protocol clients must preserve native payload access while mapping common service/layer identifiers, auth behavior, errors, and paging consistently.

entries.title: OGC API Records public catalog

sdkTargets.javascript: client.ogcRecords() or equivalent in honua-io/honua-sdk-js#139

entries.testExpectation: Server #952 adds route and contract tests; SDK issues add discovery, search, record detail, paging/filter, auth, error, and raw-payload tests.

entries.testExpectation: GeoServices catalog endpoint tests and SDK service-list tests verify visible service filtering and FeatureServer/MapServer/ImageServer entries.

entries.title: Open-data page and DCAT catalog publication
entries.audience: Anonymous users, open-data harvesters, Console public page previews, and first-party SDK public catalog clients.
entries.authPosture: Anonymous route filtered by OpenData:Enabled, Console item visibility, open-data page state, eligibility, and DCAT blocking validation.

sdkTargets.dotnet: Open-data catalog/page client for Console Share and DCAT harvest workflows
sdkTargets.javascript: Open-data browser helpers for public page, list, and raw DCAT catalog reads
sdkTargets.python: Open-data catalog client for page/list/detail and DCAT catalog reads

entries.responseKind: Public page/list JSON, application/ld+json Schema.org Dataset item projection, and DCAT/data.json-compatible catalog JSON. Public item JSON responses include the same Schema.org Dataset preview under schemaOrg. The catalog uses the same projection and currently emits up to 200 visible records.
entries.paginationFiltering: List supports cursor and limit; limit defaults to 25 and is capped at 200. Invalid or stale cursors restart at the first page. Item reads return an empty 404 for missing, private, unpublished, ineligible, disabled-capability, and validation-blocked items.
entries.testExpectation: Open-data endpoint tests cover allowed reads, JSON-LD negotiation, disabled capability gating, non-leaking denied reads, catalog output, and documented validation exceptions. SDK parity tests should add explicit cursor/list behavior coverage.

entries.title: Admin SDK compatibility and capability handshake

sdkTargets.javascript: Admin client compatibility handshake before constructing admin paths
sdkTargets.python: Admin client compatibility handshake before constructing admin paths

entries.responseKind: Admin ApiResponse envelope with server version, current metadata API version, resource kinds, metadata schema compatibility, and coarse feature flags.
entries.paginationFiltering: No paging. Capabilities are a single runtime snapshot; SDKs should branch on data.compatibility.controlPlaneApi.major and feature flags rather than probing endpoints.
entries.testExpectation: Admin endpoint tests cover version/capabilities and 401 behavior; SDK parity tests use capabilities before admin metadata, manifest, GitOps, or migration inventory calls.

entries.title: Admin open-data, DCAT, and Console STAC publication controls
entries.audience: Console Share, admin SDKs, and operator automation managing server-owned open-data page state, DCAT validation, and Console STAC publication controls.
entries.authPosture: Admin authorization required. STAC publish, update, and unpublish also run through OperatorApprovalGate.

sdkTargets.dotnet: Admin Console Share client for eligibility, page state, DCAT validation, and Console STAC publication status
sdkTargets.javascript: Console Share admin client helpers for open-data/DCAT/Console STAC publication workflows
sdkTargets.python: Admin open-data publication client where Console automation needs parity

entries.responseKind: Admin ApiResponse envelopes for reads/writes, approval-required problem responses from STAC mutations when policy gates apply, 201 Created plus Location on STAC publish, and 204 No Content on STAC unpublish. STAC publication responses are Console status readbacks; the public STAC Collection document is available from the returned Location while the record is published and eligible.
entries.paginationFiltering: No admin paging in the current contract. GET /api/v1/admin/open-data/{itemId} synthesizes an unpublished default page when no page record exists. Eligibility and validation responses preserve all blocking reasons, including OpenDataDisabled when OpenData:Enabled is false, and documented validation exceptions.
entries.testExpectation: Open-data publication tests cover eligibility reasons, disabled capability behavior, merge update/readback, denied public reads, DCAT validation/status, approval-gated STAC mutations, STAC publish/update/unpublish readback, and public STAC collection visibility/removal.
